trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks itself — it is the last one to pop.

steps.text: Finish every story chapter and mission trophy first, in roadmap order.
Clear the activity, collectible and crime sets in the cleanup stages.
The platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story beat of the game.

steps.text: Play through the opening mission until its end card.
Follow the on-screen prompts; the trophy pops at the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 — play every story mission in the chapter to its end.

steps.text: Complete every story mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete card shows.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 — play every story mission in the chapter to its end.

steps.text: Complete every story mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete card shows.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 — play every story mission in the chapter to its end.

steps.text: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete card shows.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 — play every story mission in the chapter to its end.

steps.text: Complete every story mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete card shows.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the last story beat. Any difficulty counts.

steps.text: Reach the finale and play the last story mission.
Any difficulty counts; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.text: Open the mission from the story log and play it through.
Complete its objectives; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — every line of the game's own checklist, not just the story.

steps.text: Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu and clear every line.
Story, activities, collectibles and side strands all count toward it.
The trophy pops the moment the counter hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and air time while driving. Sources disagree on what the game counts.

steps.text: Chain jumps, near misses and air time while driving around Leonida.
Stunts add up across the whole game; repeat your best jumps to farm them.
Version A: every stunt the game flashes counts. Version B: only clean landings count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once. Sources disagree on exactly which types the game counts.

steps.text: Open the activities list and try one of each type on offer.
The counter ticks once per type tried.
Version A: nine types are tracked. Version B: the list is longer and only nine named ones count.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Sources disagree on how the gold is counted.

steps.text: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Each challenge needs a gold-medal score, not just a pass.
Version A: gold on every one of the 42 challenges. Version B: gold on each range's set as a whole.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.

steps.text: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win the race.
Repeat at all 14 locations; wins are tracked per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races around Leonida.

steps.text: Enter races around Leonida and win them.
Each race counts once; 20 different wins are needed.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Take the fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him in the timed round to win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end screen.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet and start any game.
Play it to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — play it to its final mission.

steps.text: Follow Andy's strand through its missions.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — play it to its final mission.

steps.text: Follow Kenton's strand through its missions.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — play it to its final mission.

steps.text: Follow Billy's strand through its missions.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.

steps.text: Pick up stranger missions wherever their markers appear.
Each strand ends with a final mission; 8 completed strands are needed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — play it to its final mission.

steps.text: Follow Randy's strand through its missions.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — play it to its final mission.

steps.text: Follow Tyrone's strand through its missions.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end card.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Possibly missable: one spot sits on a Chapter 1 balcony, and sources disagree on whether it must be done in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Find a meditation spot and hold the prompt to meditate.
Repeat at all 18 spots across Leonida.
Version A: the Chapter 1 balcony spot must be done in Chapter 1. Version B: it stays open later.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Take Bret's hunt and track the unique animal.
Bring it down with a clean shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.

steps.text: Collect cards around Leonida and open the card album.
Finish any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida.

steps.text: Find WAiNK spots and use the prompt at each one.
100 different locations are needed.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges.

steps.text: Open the challenges list and clear any 50.
Challenges span driving, combat and exploration.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the heat. Watch for the moment — partner moments do not wait.

steps.text: Raise a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Break line of sight and escape until the stars clear.
Do it when the chance comes — partner moments do not wait.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Plan the route first — the chain breaks if the heat drops.

steps.text: Rob a shop with your partner beside you.
Hit two more shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
Plan the route first — the chain breaks if the heat drops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive each new one to log it.

steps.text: Drive a vehicle you have never driven to log it.
100 different vehicles are needed; variety beats speed.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Trigger Combat Focus with enemies grouped ahead.
Drop 5 before the focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave by a way that is not the scheduled exit. Attempt it when you are there; the moment is easy to walk past.

steps.text: Reach VCIA and find a way out that is not the scheduled exit.
A vehicle or a stunt exit both count once you are clear.
Attempt it when you are there — the moment is easy to walk past.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Face one and survive the encounter.

steps.text: Face a Rhino tank and survive the encounter.
Heavy weapons and cover help; the trophy pops when the tank is handled.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. One clean run is needed — a spotted run does not count.

steps.text: Case the jewelry store and enter unseen.
Take the goods and leave before any alarm.
One clean run is needed — a spotted run does not count.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape with the take.

steps.text: Hit a bank vault and escape with the take.
Repeat at 5 different vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — strike when the road is clear.

steps.text: Stop an armored truck and crack it open.
Escape with the cash before backup arrives.
Trucks run set routes — strike when the road is clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 named areas.

steps.text: Travel into each named area until the map fills in.
52 areas are tracked on the map screen.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

steps.text: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The trigger is not pinned down yet — only one source describes it.

steps.text: Head to Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view.
The moment is a quiet one — sit, order, enjoy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. One good run is all it takes — mind the traffic outside.

steps.text: Drive into the showroom and out through the glass.
Speed and a straight line do the job.
One good run is all it takes — mind the traffic outside.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game through to the final frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides list it as a partnership moment.

steps.text: The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides list it as a partnership moment.
Play through partner scenes and check back after each one.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The trigger is not pinned down yet — the count runs to 500 choices.

steps.text: The trigger is not pinned down yet — the count runs to 500 choices.
Keep making choices across story and side content.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides read it as succeeding on a second try.

steps.text: The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides read it as succeeding on a second try.
Retry a failed moment and finish it on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides read it as witnessing something strange.

steps.text: The trigger is not pinned down yet — guides read it as witnessing something strange.
Explore odd corners of Leonida and watch for the moment.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Drive by within melee range and swing a melee weapon.
One clean knockdown is enough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Earn Marked Bills, then launder them through a contact.
$250,000 laundered in total is needed.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

steps.text: Buy gear, clothes and upgrades across shops.
Spending adds up everywhere; $100,000 total is needed.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties.

steps.text: Save up and buy each garage property when it is listed.
All 8 are needed.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle.
10 different vehicles are needed.
